requirements.quote: The activated system shall at any time, within the boundary conditions, ensure that the vehicle does not cross a lane marking
requirements.text: The lane centring function shall, when active and within its boundary conditions, keep the vehicle from crossing a lane marking for lateral accelerations below the manufacturer's specified maximum lateral acceleration aysmax.

requirements.quote: It shall be possible to deactivate the system at any time by a single action of the driver.
requirements.text: The driver control assistance system shall provide a means for the driver to activate (standby mode) and deactivate (off mode) the system, and shall be deactivatable at any time by a single driver action, after which it shall only become active again by a deliberate driver action.

requirements.quote: The steering control effort necessary to override the directional control provided by the system shall not exceed 50 N
requirements.text: The steering control effort necessary to override the directional control provided by the system shall not exceed 50 N.

requirements.quote: Maximum value for the specified maximum lateral acceleration 3 m/s² 3 m/s² 3 m/s² 3 m/s²
requirements.text: For an M1 vehicle, the specified maximum lateral acceleration aysmax shall not exceed 3 m/s² in any of the speed ranges 10-60 km/h, >60-100 km/h, >100-130 km/h and >130 km/h.

requirements.quote: The moving average over half a second of the lateral jerk generated by the system shall not exceed 5 m/s³.
requirements.text: The moving average over half a second of the lateral jerk generated by the lane centring function shall not exceed 5 m/s³.

requirements.quote: If the system is active an optical signal shall be provided to the driver.
requirements.text: The system shall provide an optical signal to the driver when it is active.

requirements.quote: When the system is in standby mode, an optical signal shall be provided to the driver.
requirements.text: The system shall provide an optical signal to the driver when it is in standby mode.

requirements.quote: the system shall avoid sudden loss of steering support by continuing to provide assistance to the extent possible
requirements.text: When the system reaches its boundary conditions and a front tyre starts to cross the lane marking without driver steering input, it shall continue to provide assistance to the extent possible and shall clearly inform the driver by an optical warning plus an acoustic or haptic warning.

requirements.quote: A system failure shall be signalled to the driver by an optical warning signal.
requirements.text: The system shall signal a system failure to the driver by an optical warning signal.

requirements.quote: it shall provide a means of detecting that the driver is holding the steering control
requirements.text: When active between 10 km/h or Vsmin (whichever is higher) and Vsmax, the system shall provide a means of detecting that the driver is holding the steering control.

requirements.quote: If, after a period of no longer than 15 seconds the driver is not holding the steering control, an optical warning signal shall be provided.
requirements.text: If the driver is not holding the steering control for a period of no longer than 15 seconds, the system shall provide an optical warning signal instructing the driver to place their hands on the steering control.

requirements.quote: at least the hands or steering control in the pictorial information provided as optical warning signal shall be shown in red and an
requirements.text: If the driver is still not holding the steering control after a period of no longer than 30 seconds, the system shall show at least the hands or steering control in red in the pictorial warning and shall provide an acoustic warning signal.

requirements.quote: The system shall be automatically deactivated at the latest 30 seconds after the acoustic warning signal has started.
requirements.text: The system shall be automatically deactivated at the latest 30 seconds after the acoustic warning signal has started.

requirements.quote: After deactivation the system shall clearly inform the driver about the system status by an acoustic emergency signal which is different from the previous acoustic warning signal, for at least five seconds
requirements.text: After deactivation the system shall inform the driver of the system status by an acoustic emergency signal different from the previous acoustic warning, lasting at least five seconds or until the driver holds the steering control again.

requirements.quote: the optical signals described in paragraph 5.6.2.2. shall all be different from each other (e.g. different symbol, colour, blinking, text).
requirements.text: The optical signals for active mode, standby mode, boundary condition, failure and hands-off warnings shall all be different from each other (e.g. different symbol, colour, blinking or text).

requirements.quote: It shall be possible to travel along a straight section of road without unusual steering correction by the driver and without unusual vibration in the steering system
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be able to travel along a straight road section without unusual steering correction by the driver and without unusual vibration in the steering system at the maximum design speed.

requirements.quote: they shall be designed such that the driver may, at any time and by deliberate action, override the function.
requirements.text: The advanced driver assistance steering function shall be designed so that the driver may override it at any time by deliberate action, and so that it does not deteriorate the performance of the basic steering system.

requirements.quote: Every CSF intervention shall immediately be indicated to the driver by an optical warning signal which is displayed for at least 1 s or as long as the intervention exists, whichever is longer.
requirements.text: Where a corrective steering intervention occurs, it shall be indicated immediately to the driver by an optical warning signal displayed for at least 1 s or for as long as the intervention exists, whichever is longer.

requirements.quote: Any failure in a transmission other than purely mechanical shall clearly be brought to the attention of the vehicle driver as given in paragraph 5.4.
requirements.text: Any failure in the electrical steering transmission shall be clearly brought to the attention of the driver in accordance with the warning-signal provisions of paragraph 5.4.

requirements.quote: Any fault which impairs the steering function and is not mechanical in nature shall be signalled clearly to the driver of the vehicle.
requirements.text: Any non-mechanical fault that impairs the steering function shall be signalled clearly to the driver.

requirements.quote: Optical warning signals shall be visible, even by daylight and distinguishable from other alerts
requirements.text: The optical warning signals shall be visible even by daylight, distinguishable from other alerts, and verifiable by the driver from the driver's seat, and failure of a warning device component shall not cause loss of steering performance.

requirements.quote: Acoustic warning signals shall be easily recognized by the driver.
requirements.text: Acoustic warning signals shall be continuous or intermittent sound signals or vocal information, easily recognized by the driver, and where vocal information is used it shall be in the language(s) of the market of sale.

requirements.quote: Information about how the system detects that the driver is holding the steering control.
requirements.text: The system information data supplied for the lane centring function shall include information on how the system detects that the driver is holding the steering control.

requirements.quote: The signal to activate the hazard warning lights shall be generated with the start of the intervention.
requirements.text: The risk mitigation function shall generate the signal to activate the hazard warning lights with the start of the intervention.

requirements.quote: During the RMF intervention the vehicle shall slow down with a deceleration demand not greater than 4m/s², unless required by the surrounding traffic
requirements.text: During the risk mitigation intervention the vehicle shall slow down with a deceleration demand not greater than 4 m/s², except where the surrounding traffic requires otherwise.

requirements.quote: Once the RMF has brought the vehicle to a safe stop in the target stop area, the vehicle shall not move away without manual input.
requirements.text: Once the risk mitigation function has brought the vehicle to a safe stop in the target stop area, the vehicle shall not move away without manual input.

requirements.quote: This warning phase shall start at least 5 seconds before the RMF starts an intervention
requirements.text: Before every risk mitigation intervention the system shall provide an optical warning and additionally an acoustic and/or haptic warning, starting at least 5 seconds before the intervention, unless earlier vehicle control is required to prevent lane-marking crossing or maintain distance.

requirements.quote: It shall be possible to override the RMF intervention of the function at any time by a distinct action of the driver.
requirements.text: It shall be possible to override the risk mitigation intervention at any time by a distinct driver action, and the system shall implement strategies protecting against unintentional override by inputs to the driving controls.

requirements.quote: If the RMF system detects any failures preventing it from performing an intervention, this shall be signalled to the driver.
requirements.text: If the risk mitigation function detects failures preventing it from performing an intervention, this shall be signalled to the driver.

requirements.quote: The requirements of Annex 6 shall be applied to the safety aspects of electronic vehicle control systems that provide or form part of the control transmission of the steering function
requirements.text: The electronic control systems that provide or form part of the steering control transmission, including the driver assistance steering function, shall satisfy the safety-aspect requirements of Annex 6.

requirements.quote: The effectiveness of the steering equipment, including the electrical control lines, shall not be adversely affected by magnetic or electric fields.
requirements.text: The steering equipment, including its electrical control lines, shall not have its effectiveness adversely affected by magnetic or electric fields, demonstrated by fulfilling UN Regulation No. 10 (04 series for vehicles with a traction-battery charging coupling).

requirements.quote: The steering equipment shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way that it is capable of withstanding the stresses arising during normal operation of the vehicle
requirements.text: The steering equipment shall be designed, constructed and fitted so that it withstands the stresses arising during normal vehicle operation, and its maximum steering angle shall not be limited by any part of the steering transmission unless specifically designed for that purpose.

requirements.quote: Table 2 Steering control effort requirements Vehicle Category INTACT Maximum effort (daN) Time(s) Turning radius (m)
requirements.text: For an M1 vehicle the maximum permitted steering control effort with intact steering shall be 15 daN within a steering time of 4 s to a turning radius of 12 m.

requirements.quote: WITH A FAILURE Maximum Effort (daN) Time(s) Turning Radius (m)
requirements.text: For an M1 vehicle with a failure in the steering equipment the maximum permitted steering control effort shall be 30 daN within a steering time of 4 s to a turning radius of 20 m.

requirements.quote: It shall be possible to leave a curve with a radius of 50 m at a tangent without unusual vibration in the steering equipment
requirements.text: It shall be possible for the M1 vehicle to leave a 50 m radius curve at a tangent at 50 km/h without unusual vibration in the steering equipment.

requirements.quote: all performance tests shall be carried out under conditions of actual or simulated electrical load of all essential systems or systems components which share the same energy supply
requirements.text: All performance tests shall be carried out under conditions of actual or simulated electrical load of all essential systems sharing the same energy supply, comprising at least lighting, windscreen wipers, engine management and braking systems.

requirements.quote: The vehicle shall verify the authenticity and integrity of messages it receives
requirements.text: The vehicle shall verify the authenticity and integrity of the messages it receives (mitigation M10).

requirements.quote: Security controls shall be implemented for storing cryptographic keys (e.g., use of Hardware Security Modules)
requirements.text: Security controls shall be implemented for storing the cryptographic keys used by the assistance system (e.g. hardware security modules) (mitigation M11).

requirements.quote: Access control techniques and designs shall be applied to protect system data/code
requirements.text: Access control techniques and designs shall be applied to protect the assistance system data and code against manipulation, overwrite and erasure (mitigation M7).

requirements.quote: Measures to detect and recover from a denial of service attack shall be employed
requirements.text: Measures to detect and recover from a denial of service attack on the assistance system's communication channels shall be employed (mitigation M13).

requirements.quote: Measures to prevent and detect unauthorized access shall be employed
requirements.text: Measures to prevent and detect unauthorized access to the assistance system shall be employed (mitigation M9).

requirements.quote: Measures to detect malicious internal messages or activity should be considered
requirements.text: Measures to detect malicious internal messages or activity on the vehicle networks used by the assistance system should be considered (mitigation M15).

requirements.quote: Confidential data transmitted to or from the vehicle shall be protected
requirements.text: Confidential data transmitted to or from the vehicle shall be protected (mitigation M12).

requirements.quote: Secure software update procedures shall be employed
requirements.text: Secure software update procedures shall be employed for updates to the assistance system software (mitigation M16).

requirements.quote: Security controls shall be applied to external interfaces
requirements.text: Security controls shall be applied to the external interfaces of the vehicle (mitigation M22).

requirements.quote: Software shall be security assessed, authenticated and integrity protected.
requirements.text: Software shall be security assessed, authenticated and integrity protected, and security controls applied to minimise the risk from third-party software hosted on the vehicle (mitigation M21).

requirements.quote: Cybersecurity best practices for software and hardware development shall be followed
requirements.text: Cybersecurity best practices for software and hardware development shall be followed (mitigation M23).

requirements.quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall identify the critical elements of the vehicle type and perform an exhaustive risk assessment for the vehicle type
requirements.text: The manufacturer shall identify the critical elements of the vehicle type and perform an exhaustive risk assessment for the vehicle type considering the individual elements and their interactions with external systems, covering all threats in Annex 5 Part A.

requirements.quote: Proportionate mitigations shall be implemented to protect the vehicle type.
requirements.text: The vehicle manufacturer shall protect the vehicle type against the risks identified in its risk assessment by implementing proportionate mitigations, including all relevant mitigations of Annex 5 Parts B and C.

requirements.quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall perform, prior to type approval, appropriate and sufficient testing to verify the effectiveness of the security measures implemented.
requirements.text: The vehicle manufacturer shall perform, prior to type approval, appropriate and sufficient testing to verify the effectiveness of the implemented cyber security measures.

requirements.quote: Detect and prevent cyber-attacks against vehicles of the vehicle type
requirements.text: The vehicle manufacturer shall implement measures for the vehicle type to detect and prevent cyber-attacks, support monitoring, and provide data forensic capability to analyse attempted or successful attacks.

requirements.quote: Cryptographic modules used for the purpose of this Regulation shall be in line with consensus standards.
requirements.text: Cryptographic modules used for the purpose of this Regulation shall be in line with consensus standards, or their use shall be justified by the manufacturer.

requirements.quote: The authenticity and integrity of software updates shall be protected to reasonably prevent their compromise and reasonably prevent invalid updates.
requirements.text: The authenticity and integrity of software updates shall be protected to reasonably prevent their compromise and reasonably prevent invalid updates.

requirements.quote: the vehicle is able to restore systems to their previous version in case of a failed or interrupted update or that the vehicle can be placed into a safe state
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be able to restore systems to their previous version in case of a failed or interrupted update, or be placed into a safe state after a failed or interrupted update.

requirements.quote: software updates can only be executed when the vehicle has enough power to complete the update process
requirements.text: Software updates shall only be executed when the vehicle has enough power to complete the update process, including power needed for recovery to the previous version or for placing the vehicle into a safe state.

requirements.quote: When the execution of an update may affect the safety of the vehicle, the vehicle manufacturer shall demonstrate how the update will be executed safely.
requirements.text: When execution of an update may affect vehicle safety, the update shall be executed through technical means ensuring the vehicle is in a state where the update can safely be executed.

requirements.quote: the vehicle user is able to be informed about an update before the update is executed
requirements.text: The vehicle user shall be informed before an update is executed about the purpose of the update, changes to vehicle functions, expected completion time, unavailable functionalities and safe-execution instructions.

requirements.quote: In the situation where the execution of an update whilst driving may not be safe
requirements.text: Where executing an update whilst driving may not be safe, the vehicle shall prevent the vehicle from being driven during execution and prevent the driver from using any functionality affecting safety or the successful execution of the update.

requirements.quote: The vehicle user is able to be informed of the success (or failure) of the update
requirements.text: After execution of an update the vehicle user shall be informed of the success or failure of the update and of the changes implemented and any related updates to the user manual.

requirements.quote: The vehicle shall ensure that preconditions have to be met before the software update is executed.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall ensure that preconditions must be met before the software update is executed.

requirements.quote: Each RXSWIN shall be uniquely identifiable.
requirements.text: Where an RXSWIN is used, each RXSWIN shall be uniquely identifiable, and shall be updated when type-approval-relevant software is modified such that it leads to a type approval extension or a new type approval.

requirements.quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall protect the RXSWINs and/or software version(s) on a vehicle against unauthorised modification.
requirements.text: The manufacturer shall protect the RXSWINs and/or software versions on the vehicle against unauthorised modification and shall confidentially provide the means implemented to do so at type approval.
